mission.title: Zoochemy
mission.description: Carry the biological interface program to Silver in your own signal, then see it passed on to Tarka and safely into a new mainframe.

npc.say: What is that pithy saying you gutbowls came up with? Oh, yes: "Keep it in your pants."
Well, what are we waiting for, more Agents to show up?

phase.briefing: Operative, Silver has requested that you proceed to the biological interface program's location. I don't know what sort of experiment he's got in mind, but it won't put me out too badly even if it fries your jacks, so I've decided to humor him this time.

enter.say: The program should be on a secure mainframe in there. So far we've been able to keep that location a secret from the Machines.

objective.text: Check on the interface program at the mainframe

done.say:
What th-?! What was that? Some kind of program just merged into your broadcast signal! Was that one of those new consumables, or...
Wait, there's the record. No... Nothing I've seen before. Is it the interface program?
Man, this is weird. We'd better check with Flood.

phase.briefing:
Of all the idiotic--
Yes, there was something about the program making an escape from a Machine attack the other day by piggy-backing onto an operative's signal, but this isn't the sort of thing I want to make a habit of--especially with you! Why, imagine what Halborn, for instance, would do if he came across you right now, with that program he's desperate for sitting there in your RSI.
Bah. Well, it's too late now. Get to Silver with your "guest." He'd better get that thing out of you and into somewhere secure post-haste.

enter.say: You feeling all right? Your readings look normal... Heck, if I hadn't seen the transfer happen, I wouldn't even believe that thing was in you.

talk.say:
Hm... Yes... Interesting... Any discomfort? Mm... And no additional slurring of speech...
Good, then we can proceed. You'll be meeting up with another selected human; oh, and try to stay away from anyone else, would you? We don't want the program moving to another host just yet.

phase.briefing:
You're supposed to rendezvous with an operative of ours named Tarka.
Try to stay away from those phone booths for once, would you? You never know what trampish operatives you'll run across at those places. Just do that jumping thing of yours.

enter.say: Tarka's in there waiting for you. They've been keeping everyone else clear, so you should have the place to yourselves.

talk.say:
Oh, so you're {player}. Now what do we--
Whoa. Did you feel something?

done.say: Hey, was that... I think the program may have just jumped from you to Tarka.
Uh-oh, you've got Machines on your tail! Get out of there!
Well, what are we waiting for, more Agents to show up?

objective.text: Lead Tarka out of the area

near.say: You are under arrest for transportation of an illegal program!

phase.briefing: Apparently there's one more part to this experiment, {player}. Get Tarka to the secure mainframe that's been prepared, and try not to lead the Machines right to it this time, hm?

enter.say: I think you managed to ditch the Machines. They've got the mainframe in there all prepped for Tarka to do...whatever's supposed to happen.

done.say:
There it goes, tucked back into a mainframe again.
What do you think Silver was testing?

mission.finish:
Hmph. Silver's mighty pleased with himself; he claims that the transferrals you just helped execute show that the program can interface perfectly with human broadcast signals. Rather disgusting, if you ask me... Why, next he'll be trying to use it to insert programs into actual human bodies, or some other perverted scheme.
Ugh! I'm gagging just thinking about it.
